# World Meteorological Organization (WMO)

> The United Nations agency for weather, climate, water resources, and early warning systems serving 193 member states globally.

WMO is the authoritative international voice on the state and behavior of Earth's atmosphere, its interaction with oceans, and the climate it produces. The organization coordinates global meteorological services, promotes scientific research, and supports member countries in building resilience to extreme weather and climate impacts.

## Key Topics

- World Meteorological Organization
- Early Warnings for All
- El Niño / La Niña (ENSO)

- Climate Monitoring
